purpose: Prevent evaluation on splits too short for independent strategy warmup

lifecycle.idea: Audit whether structurally valid splits can actually warm up the registered strategy
lifecycle.source: Critique of RUN-M0-S4-PLAN-20260816 and research-methodology limits
lifecycle.hypothesis: Each four-bar split is insufficient for independent SMA(5) warmup
lifecycle.result: BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_BARS; deficit 21 bars in every split
lifecycle.critique: The 20 scored-bar threshold is mechanical, not statistical
lifecycle.decision: Retain previous immutable evidence but block strategy evaluation
lifecycle.lesson: Plan structure, mechanical sufficiency and statistical sufficiency require separate gates

limitations: Threshold 20 is not statistical power analysis
Only window-based lookback parameters are recognized
No regime, trade-count or autocorrelation adequacy is assessed
verification: missing window, draft criteria and boolean bar count fail closed
lessons: A green structural gate can still feed a blocked sufficiency gate
Warmup must be explicit and independent per split
Negative evidence improves the pipeline without increasing maturity
